text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mirror Wall Shelf, 21.75"H, Natural
Materials: wood
This triangular mirror with shelves is a perfect accent for modern or traditional home décor. Just the right size for displaying knickknacks and small treasures, the shelves are made of fir wood and finished with a rich natural brown. The mirror adds a sense of space to the room. 21.75"H x 25"W x 4"D Fir wood with MDF and mirror This wall shelf's clean lines and beautiful natural finish make it an ideal addition to a variety of home-décor styles. No hanging materials needed
